zh.title: 國防部偵獲7艘共艦2艘公務船與2架共機台海活動
zh.summary: 國防部於台海周邊偵獲7艘共艦、2艘公務船與2架次共機，國軍嚴密監控應處。
body: 台灣國防部今（24）日公布最新共機艦動態，統計自8月23日上午6時起至8月24日上午6時止，共計偵獲7艘共艦、2艘公務船以及2架次共機，持續在台灣海峽周邊海空域活動。
針對中共機艦及公務船在台海周邊的活動，國防部強調，國軍持續運用任務機艦與岸置飛彈系統，進行嚴密監控與妥適應處，以掌握周邊動態。
另據本站統計紀錄顯示，前一次於8月22日記錄到共機3架次、共艦8艘與公務船7艘；近7日平均每日為共機8.2架次與共艦7.8艘，近30日平均則為共機6.5架次與共艦8.0艘。

en.title: Taiwan Detects 7 Chinese Warships, 2 Official Ships, and 2 Aircraft Around Strait
en.summary: Taiwan's defense ministry detected seven Chinese warships, two official vessels, and two aircraft around the Strait.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense announced on August 24 that seven Chinese military vessels, two official ships, and two Chinese military aircraft were detected operating around the Taiwan Strait between 6:00 a.m. on August 23 and 6:00 a.m. on August 24.

In response to the activities around the Taiwan Strait, the defense ministry stated that Taiwan's armed forces deployed task aircraft, naval vessels, and shore-based missile systems to maintain close monitoring and respond appropriately.

According to this site's recorded statistics, previous data from August 22 recorded three Chinese aircraft, eight military vessels, and seven official ships. Over the past seven days, the daily average stood at 8.2 aircraft and 7.8 military vessels, while the 30-day daily average was 6.5 aircraft and 8.0 military vessels.
